verdicts.title: Topological Entropy for Arbitrary Subsets of Infinite Product Spaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this note a notion of generalized topological entropy for arbitrary subsets of the space of all sequences in a compact topological space is introduced. It is shown that for a continuous map on a compact space the generalized topological entropy of the set of all orbits of the map coincides with the classical topological entropy of the map. verdicts.title: Entropy as a Topological Operad Derivation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We share a small connection between information theory, algebra, and topology - namely, a correspondence between Shannon entropy and derivations of the operad of topological simplices.
